verdicts.why: Quill asks Kraglin to help save Nebula, Drax and Mantis from the High Evolutionary, and Kraglin pilots Knowhere to Arête and blasts a hole in it so the Guardians can get in.

value.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
value.text: A Gamora from 2014, who never knew Groot, joins the Guardians' mission to save Rocket. When Groot and Quill leap from Arête with Theel, she picks them up in the ship, and they part warmly when she leaves with the Ravagers.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian this Gamora never knew, who leaps from Arête into her ship.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A Gamora from 2014 who never knew Groot. Picks him up after his leap from Arête.

verdicts.why: They do deal with each other in Vol. 3 (Orgoscope mission, she picks up Groot and Quill after their leap from Arête, Groot tells her he liked working with her). The tie's other Vol. 3 stages for this Gamora with Guardians she never knew (Drax, Rocket) are ally, so ally matches.

Hill extracts Rogers, Romanoff and Wilson to the safehouse where the supposedly dead Fury is hiding, and after Rogers swaps the last chip Hill takes control and has the Helicarriers destroy each other.

Mid-credits: List and Strucker discuss what to do with the twins, the only surviving subjects of their scepter experiments, who are shown held in the lab. Credits scenes belong to their film, and keeping them as test subjects is List acting on them, not a mention or vision.
Same mid-credits scene: List and Strucker discuss the surviving twin test subjects, shown held in the Hydra lab.

dr-list|pietro-maximoff.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
dr-list|pietro-maximoff.text: In a HYDRA lab, Dr. List and Strucker keep Pietro as one of two surviving test subjects of their scepter experiments, and List asks what is to be done with the twins.
dr-list|pietro-maximoff.on_a_card_about_b: A test subject List keeps in his HYDRA lab.
dr-list|pietro-maximoff.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist who keeps Pietro as a test subject.

dr-list|wanda-maximoff.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
dr-list|wanda-maximoff.text: In a HYDRA lab, Dr. List and Strucker keep Wanda as one of two surviving test subjects of their scepter experiments, and List asks what is to be done with the twins.
dr-list|wanda-maximoff.on_a_card_about_b: A test subject List keeps in his HYDRA lab.
dr-list|wanda-maximoff.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist who keeps Wanda as a test subject.

verdicts.why: The twins are physically held in List's lab as his surviving test subjects while he discusses what to do with them; that is one acting on the other in a scene, not a vision, mention or recording, and credits scenes belong to their film. Keep the stages as proposed in items 3 and 4.

In Berlin the triggered Winter Soldier strangles Romanoff until T'Challa intervenes; at Leipzig-Halle she tasers Black Panther so Rogers and Barnes reach the Quinjet. Her letting him go turns them toward the ally stage that follows.
At Leipzig-Halle Hawkeye pins Black Widow, she asks if they are still friends, and he says it depends how hard she hits him.
F.R.I.D.A.Y. assists Tony at the airport, identifies the fake psychiatrist as Helmut Zemo, and in Siberia analyzes Captain America's fight pattern on Tony's order so he can counter.
Both back the Accords (Natasha tells Steve that Rhodes has signed) and fight together on Stark's team at Leipzig-Halle, where Rhodes is shot down by Vision's misfire.
In the Accords debate Sam asks Natasha if she is the same woman who told the government to kiss her ass; they end on opposite teams at the airport.
Natasha finds Steve after Peggy's funeral ('I didn't want you to be alone') and at the airport lets him and Barnes escape, holding off Black Panther.
Natasha sides with Stark on the Accords and joins his team; after she lets Rogers go they argue and Stark tells her T'Challa told Ross, so they are coming for her.
Both are in the Accords debate at the compound, Natasha tells Steve that Vision has signed, and both fight on Stark's team at Leipzig-Halle.
Rogers and Wilson protect Barnes in Bucharest, go rogue and fight at Leipzig-Halle; Wilson is held at the Raft and Rogers breaks his allies out.

value.title: Thor: The Dark World
value.text: Darcy interrupts Jane's date to bring her to the London factory where strange readings have appeared, and later stands with her at Greenwich using Selvig's devices against the Dark Elves.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Friend Darcy pulls from a date to chase strange readings.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who pulls Jane from a date to chase strange readings.

verdicts.why: The events are right, but the line on Darcy's card names Jane first, against the card rule; reworded so the described person is not named first.
Thor and Jane reunite in London with her mentor Selvig, who locates the Convergence at Greenwich, and his device teleports the falling Ark away from Thor and Jane.
Selvig greets Thor at Jane's apartment and works out Greenwich; Thor uses Selvig's devices on Malekith, and Selvig's device sends the Ark away as it nearly crushes Thor.
Thor arrives in London alerted by Heimdall to Jane's disappearance; Heimdall reluctantly agrees to Thor's plan in the tavern and then distracts Odin by confessing treason.
Sif holds back the guards during Thor's escape with Loki and Jane, and with her sword at his throat warns 'Betray him, and I will kill you'; Loki answers 'Nice to see you, too, Sif.'
Volstagg warns Loki he will kill him if he betrays Thor ('Evidently, there will be a line'), and Fandral mocks Loki's ungraceful fall into the skiff.
Sif fights with the Warriors Three on Vanaheim, and she, Fandral and Volstagg help Thor, Jane and Loki escape Asgard.
On Vanaheim Sif blocks a missile aimed at Thor, later tries to rekindle his feelings over a drink he declines, and frees Jane from her guards for Thor's plan.
The Warriors Three fight beside Thor on Vanaheim; Volstagg holds off the Einherjar and Fandral flies the skiff and fights off pursuers so Thor can escape.
At the factory Darcy catches up with Thor and asks how space is; back at Jane's apartment she greets them before the group heads to Greenwich.
Heimdall joins Thor, Sif, Fandral and Volstagg in the secret meeting, explains that Loki knows other ways off Asgard, and later distracts Odin.
Both are in Thor's secret meeting; Sif frees Jane from her guards while Heimdall summons Odin and confesses treason.
Fandral tells Odin the palace shields are still down and Asgard is all but defenseless; he and Volstagg then help Thor escape despite Odin's order that none leave.
Logan angrily confronts Xavier in the infirmary over the psychic blocks in Jean's mind, and at the Grey house he watches, pinned by her power, as Jean disintegrates Xavier.
In the mansion tunnels Bobby reminds Logan there are only six of them, Logan rallies them and Bobby says they're in; at Alcatraz Logan asks Bobby if he can take down Pyro, and he does.
Logan fills in for Scott in the Danger Room session with Kitty in it, then rallies her, Bobby and Peter, who signal they are ready, before flying to Alcatraz.
Xavier tells Storm that Scott is a changed man after Jean's death, then senses Scott's distress telepathically and sends Logan and Storm to Alkali Lake.
After Hank's news, Rogue walks in and asks if it is true they can cure them, and Xavier admits it appears to be true.

In Xavier's ethics class Kitty says Einstein called ethics an exclusively human concern, and Xavier replies that Einstein wasn't a mutant, as far as they know. Teacher and student, so mentor before the later ally stage fits.
Both are in the Danger Room session, and in the tunnels Kitty and Peter both signal to Bobby they're ready before the six X-Men fly to Alcatraz and hold the line together.
